description: Implementation of EmailService for handling email configurations and sending HTML emails within the SalesManager platform.

classes.name: EmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing email functionalities including sending emails and handling email configurations.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email to a specified store using configured email settings.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the email configuration for a given merchant store by parsing stored JSON configuration.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the provided EmailConfig for a merchant store, serializing it to JSON format.
